functions.name: template
functions.signature: template(bmp: Bytes, tpl: Bytes) -> Result[Bytes, Text]
functions.input-encoding: RFC-0043-A2 self-describing packed header: width u32 LE, height u32 LE, format u8 (0=bgra8,1=grey8), reserved u8[3]=0, pixels (width*height*bpp)
functions.result-encoding: RFC-0043-A1 region: 16 B little-endian x u32, y u32, width u32, height u32 (width/height = template dims); error arm = RFC-0041 image-error case name Text
functions.algorithm: SAD template match, integer-only, row-major scan (y outer, x inner), ties by lowest (y,x)

refusal-corpus.limit-plus-one: allocation-limit and dimension-overflow exercised at the 2^28 byte ceiling and the u64 w*h*bpp overflow edge
